title: The FDIC says it insures deposits to at least $250,000 per depositor, per ownership category, at each insured bank
summary: The FDIC says it insures deposits to at least $250,000 per depositor, per ownership category, at each insured bank.
body: The FDIC says it insures deposits to at least $250,000 per depositor, per ownership category, at each FDIC-insured bank. The source says: "One way we do this is by insuring deposits to at least $250,000 per depositor, per ownership category at each FDIC-insured bank." The limit is stated per depositor, per ownership category, per bank. It is not a single cap on a person's wealth, and it is not a guarantee of non-deposit products.
